Name: COP4813
Description: This course covers development of web systems with a focus on client-side development. Topics include use of XHTML, the Document Object Model (DOM), Cascading Style Sheets (CSS), use of Javascript for providing client side interactivity, ADA accessibility, Javascript Object Notation (JSON), and design for mobile platforms. A web site design project is included.

2 -Building a Full Website with HTML, Images, and Links
4 - Introduction to the Document Object Model (DOM)
6 - External Libraries: jQuery, Bootstrap, and Plotting Tools
7 - Drawing and Graphics with the HTML5 Canvas
8 - Introduction to JSON and Using It in the Browser
12 - Dynamic Objects and Controls with JavaScript and the DOM
14 - Content Management Systems, Webmaster Roles, and Site Maintenance
